**Procter & Gamble** should have the higher net margin in fiscal 2026, by roughly 15.6 percentage points. This is an estimate. Neither company's fiscal 2026 results were available to me (P&G's year ends June 2026 and Costco's ends August 2026), so I projected from fiscal 2025 results.

- **P&G:** Fiscal 2025 net sales were about $84.3B and net earnings about $16.0B, a margin of about 18.8%. I assume a similar margin of about 18.7% for fiscal 2026.
- **Costco:** Fiscal 2025 revenue was about $275B and net income about $8.1B, a margin of about 2.9%. I assume about 3.0–3.1% for fiscal 2026, as revenue grows to roughly $293B and net income to roughly $8.9B.

The gap is therefore about 18.7% minus 3.1%, or roughly 15.6 percentage points.
